import pathlib,json,subprocess,hashlib,os,time,shutil,re
repo=pathlib.Path(r'C:/Users/Dan/Desktop/Projects/formal-pvnp'); pkg=repo/'certifications/realizable-hardness'
out=pkg/'.lake/build/geometry-independent-review-20260912'; out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
hash=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
candidate='046703c2a1e7ab150c0bd3d7f80fc3a12b0d1eda'
mp=pkg/'geometry-draft-source-map.json'; assert hash(mp.read_bytes())=='4271e2b6257c57d75173a0969a4b6dc9736e9276b3d0d94995e943b1c38d7301'
m=json.loads(mp.read_text()); recon=[]
for e in m['entries']:
 b=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',e['source_commit']+':'+e['source_path']],cwd=repo)
 assert hash(b)==e['source_git_bytes_sha256']
 for t in e['transforms']:
  if t['operation']=='normalize_crlf_to_lf': b=b.replace(b'\r\n',b'\n')
  elif t['operation']=='remove_utf8_bom':
   assert b.startswith(b'\xef\xbb\xbf'); b=b[3:]
  elif t['operation']=='replace_utf8_literal':
   x=t['before'].encode(); assert b.count(x)==1; b=b.replace(x,t['after'].encode())
  else: raise Exception(t)
 assert hash(b)==e['mirror_sha256']; assert b==(pkg/e['mirror_path']).read_bytes()
 frozen=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',candidate+':certifications/realizable-hardness/'+e['mirror_path']],cwd=repo)
 assert frozen==b
 recon.append({'path':e['mirror_path'],'sha256':hash(b),'reconstruction':'PASS','candidate_match':True})
base=json.loads((repo/'research/p-equals-np/2026-09-12-realizable-hardness-companion-proof-verification.json').read_text())
# Validate accepted independent dependencies rather than accepting author artifacts.
for e in base['exports']:
 assert hash(pathlib.Path(e['output']).read_bytes())==e['output_sha256']
env=os.environ.copy(); env['LEAN_PATH']=str(out/'lib/lean')+';'+base['environment']['LEAN_PATH']; env['LEAN_NUM_THREADS']='1'; env['PYTHONIOENCODING']='utf-8'; env['PYTHONUTF8']='1'
assert str(pkg/'.lake/build/lib/lean').lower() not in env['LEAN_PATH'].lower()
version=subprocess.check_output(['lean','--version'],cwd=pkg,env=env,text=True).strip(); assert version==base['environment']['toolchain']
result={'candidate_commit':candidate,'source_map_sha256':hash(mp.read_bytes()),'source_reconstruction':recon,'environment':{'LEAN_PATH':env['LEAN_PATH'],'LEAN_NUM_THREADS':'1','toolchain':version},'exports':[],'runner_source':pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text()}
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
print('PASS strict reconstruction 6; accepted independent outputs 34; pinned toolchain',flush=True)
for e in m['entries']:
 source=pkg/e['mirror_path']; mod='.'.join(pathlib.PurePosixPath(e['mirror_path']).with_suffix('').parts[1:]); dest=out/'lib/lean'/pathlib.Path(*mod.split('.')).with_suffix('.olean'); dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 assert shutil.disk_usage('C:/').free>=768*1024**2
 log=out/(mod.split('.')[-1]+'-'+str(time.time_ns())+'.log'); command=['lean','-o',str(dest),str(source)]
 print('START',mod,flush=True)
 with log.open('wb') as f:
  child=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=pkg,env=env,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  print('PID',child.pid,flush=True)
  while True:
   try: code=child.wait(timeout=10); break
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    if shutil.disk_usage('C:/').free<640*1024**2:
     subprocess.run(['taskkill','/PID',str(child.pid),'/T','/F'],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL);code=child.wait();break
 (out/(log.stem+'.exit.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':code,'command':command})); raw=log.read_bytes(); s=raw.decode('utf-8'); profiles=re.findall(r"'([^']+)' (depends on axioms: \[([^\]]*)\]|does not depend on any axioms)",s)
 queries=re.findall(r'^#print axioms (\S+)',source.read_text(),re.M)
 row={'module':mod,'source':str(source),'source_sha256':hash(source.read_bytes()),'command':command,'exit_code':code,'log':str(log),'log_sha256':hash(raw),'raw_log_utf8':s,'output':str(dest),'output_sha256':hash(dest.read_bytes()) if dest.exists() else None,'query_order':queries,'axiom_profiles':profiles}
 result['exports'].append(row); (out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
 print('END',mod,'EXIT',code,'PROFILES',len(profiles),flush=True)
 assert code==0; assert len(profiles)==len(queries); assert 'sorryAx' not in s
 for q,p in zip(queries,profiles):
  assert p[0].split('.')[-1]==q
  assert set(x.strip() for x in p[2].split(',') if x.strip())<={'propext','Classical.choice','Quot.sound'}
assert sum(len(e['axiom_profiles']) for e in result['exports'])==53
print('ALL6 EXIT0; 53 STANDARD-SUBSET PROFILES',flush=True)
